title: Three blades. Two pages. Your adventure.
summary: The Adventure Update takes Line beyond the first page. Pick a weapon, choose where to fight and where to recover, spend your ink with Nib, and face the Ink Queen.

sections.title: Choose how you fight
items: Scrapsteel keeps a balanced three-hit combo, with gifts for faster swings and stronger perfect-block counters.
Pagebreaker trades speed for reach and impact. Its third strike breaks Warder shields; its signature gifts add a forward shockwave and a stronger finishing blow.
Emberbrand attacks quickly at close range and sets enemies alight. Develop longer burns or explosions when burning enemies fall.
Fourteen gifts: eight shared upgrades and two unique gifts for each weapon. Choices only offer gifts your weapon can use.

sections.title: A bigger journey
items: Eight stops across two chapters, with four forks that always move you forward. Choose regular or harder battles, then decide between Nib’s shop and free recovery.
Multi-wave fights, five arena layouts, cover, and floor ink that warns before it becomes dangerous. Harder routes earn more ink.
One currency: ink. Shop prices, health refills, and immediate effects are visible before buying. Each item can be bought once at that stop.
Short story moments with Line, the Margin, Nib, and the Ink Queen connect the journey.

sections.title: Learn the new enemies
items: Warders block blade hits from the front. Circle them, parry their slow swing, or break through with Pagebreaker’s third strike.
Blotters mark your location before dropping an ink pool. Leave the circle before it fills; floor ink cannot be blocked.
The Scribbled Brute guards the first page. The Ink Queen waits on the second, with quill fans, marked pools, radial volleys, and a second phase.

sections.title: A clearer fight, safer checkpoints
items: Guard now interrupts a swing immediately, including while holding Swing on touch. Touch guard aims toward nearby incoming shots, and Dash shows its recharge on the button.
Damage feedback names what hit you. A defeat explains whether an attack passed your guard, broke it, or came from unguardable floor ink.
Inspect your weapon and gifts during a pause or between encounters. The end-of-run summary includes combat time, enemies cleared, perfect blocks, retries, ink earned, and damage taken.

Route decisions, story stops, unchosen gifts, recovery stops, shop stock, and purchases save immediately. Combat resumes at the encounter entrance; retries restore that entrance without duplicating ink or gifts.

sections.title: Returning from 2.0
sections.paragraph: The Adventure uses a new checkpoint format, so unfinished 2.0 runs begin a fresh adventure. Your settings, completed tutorial, and First Page clear records are kept. Adventure records are tracked separately. Saves remain on this browser and device.

title: A fresh page. A whole new fight.
summary: Stick & Swing has been rebuilt around a simple idea: read the attack, make your move, and make every swing count. The First Page is a complete short run with four rooms and one boss.

sections.title: What’s new
items: A five-step playable tutorial for movement, sword combos, dashing, blocking, and perfect blocks. Practice is safe, and you can skip straight into a run.
A three-hit sword combo, optional hold-to-attack, clear enemy warnings, guard breaks, and reflected projectiles. Perfect blocks power up your next swing.
Three distinct enemies: the close-range Scrapper, charging Skitter, and ranged Spitter. Inkstones provide cover in the middle rooms.
The Scribbled Brute returns with charges, expanding shockwaves, projectile fans, and a faster second phase.
Choose a meaningful upgrade between rooms: longer reach, quicker dashes, a third-hit burst, stronger swings, more health, or healing perfect blocks.
Room checkpoints, saved reward choices, pause-on-focus-loss, touch controls with aim assist, and a reduced-effects setting.

sections.title: A new beginning
sections.paragraph: This release replaces the previous Story and Wave modes, shop, and equipment systems. Old saves are not compatible with the remake; your first visit starts a new run. The First Page is the first playable chapter. More chapters and weapon styles will follow as the game grows.

sections.title: A home for every update
sections.paragraph: News now has its own page, and future game slots have moved to Coming Soon. The arcade homepage is dedicated to games you can play today.

title: The arcade is open.
summary: WebyIsBored is now a home for a growing collection of browser games. Pick a game, jump in, and return to the arcade whenever you’re ready for something else.

sections.title: The starting lineup
sections.paragraph: Stick & Swing is our first playable game. Three clearly marked spaces are reserved for future games. More to play as we build them.
